page.title: Skill Centre
page.subtitle: Manage installed skills and MCP servers, or add new ones from the store.

badge.builtinHint: Baked into the sandbox image and cannot be uninstalled. Its bundled scripts and resources are readable by the agent.
badge.hostHint: Installed on the backend host and cannot be uninstalled. Only its SKILL.md applies — the agent cannot read its bundled files, because its tools run in the sandbox.

mine.emptyHint: Pick something from the store, or upload your own.
mine.confirmPack: “{{name}}” is a pack — uninstalling removes all {{count}} skills in it. Continue?

store.empty: The store has no entries yet.

publish.title: Upload to the skill store
publish.updateBody: Replace the public store version with the current “{{name}}”?
publish.publicNotice: After upload, every user can find and install this skill. Make sure it contains no keys, account details, or other private information.
publish.resubmitBody: Send “{{name}}” back to the skill store?
publish.reviewNotice: An admin reviews your submission; once approved, every user can find and install it. Make sure it contains no keys, account details, or other private information.

create.title: Create a skill in chat
create.subtitle: Describe the capability you want. The agent will clarify, create, and validate it in a real conversation.
create.briefPlaceholder: For example: create a skill that summarizes competitor updates every week with linked sources.
create.chatHint: You’ll move to a new conversation where you can keep refining it naturally.

install.title: Install
install.dependsTitle: This skill needs an MCP server
install.dependsHint: Its instructions call tools these servers provide. Without them the skill loads and then fails at its first tool call.
install.dependsWarning: Some dependencies are unchecked — the skill may not work.

upload.batchNameHint: Custom name applies to a single file only. Batch uploads use each archive's name.
upload.title: Add a skill or MCP server
upload.subtitle: Add an archive, SKILL.md, Git repository, or MCP server to Mine.
upload.frontmatterHint: Frontmatter supports icon (an emoji) and requires-mcp (MCP server names it depends on).
upload.gitHint: https, git or ssh. An install.sh in the repo runs automatically.
upload.remoteHint: Remote servers try Streamable HTTP first and fall back to SSE.
upload.jsonHint: Accepts an mcpServers / servers wrapper, or a single server object.

jsonError.invalidShape: Unrecognised shape — paste a server object or an mcpServers map.
jsonError.noServers: No MCP servers found in that configuration.
jsonError.needName: A single server object needs a name.

deps.title: This skill needs MCP servers
deps.subtitle: “{{skill}}” calls tools these servers provide. Set them up now and it will work straight away.
deps.unknown: Not in the store, so these have to be added by hand: {{names}}

withdraw.title: Withdraw from the store
withdraw.body: Take “{{name}}” out of the skill store?
withdraw.notice: Once withdrawn it no longer appears in the store and nobody new can install it; people who already installed it keep their copy. Your published version is kept, so you can resubmit at any time.

mediaTemplates.perfectFilmNote: The agent reviews clips and regenerates them when needed. This may take longer and cost more.
mediaTemplates.authorHint: Ask the agent to make a template from your finished work in a professional conversation.
mediaTemplates.makePrompt: I approve this finished work. Read media-template-author and draft a reusable production recipe for my review. The finished asset ID is {{assetId}}.
mediaTemplates.revisePrompt: Read media-template-author and help revise template edition {{editionId}}. Ask what I want to change, then show me the recipe before saving a new version.
mediaTemplates.emptyMine: Drafts saved in professional chat appear here.
mediaTemplates.submitDescription: Admins compare the original work, trial inputs and trial result. Once approved, the recipe and original preview appear in the library.
mediaTemplates.consent: I have the rights to share the original work and agree to show its preview in the library.
mediaTemplates.working: Production is running. You can follow it in the original conversation.
mediaTemplates.awaiting: Reply to the agent in professional chat, then refresh here.
mediaTemplates.headline: Poster headline
mediaTemplates.name: Name
mediaTemplates.reviewDescription: Compare the original work, inputs and trial result for this version.
mediaTemplates.noEvidence: This historical item has no trial evidence.
